title: Keyboard trap — focus cannot leave the element
user_impact: The page becomes effectively unusable for keyboard users.
technical_impact: Missing focus management in modal elements.

checks.source: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap; WAI-ARIA 1.2 aria-modal, HTML §4.11.4 dialog showModal()
checks.applicability: Pages where keyboard focus can be moved to a component: at least one focusable node other than the document root.
checks.expectation:
On every page with a focusable component: one page-wide UNTESTED note
(needs_review). In addition one needs_review per modal dialog in the
accessibility tree (role dialog/alertdialog with modal=true: aria-modal="true"
or a native dialog opened with showModal()), because a modal deliberately
keeps focus and must let it go again. A non-modal dialog (no aria-modal, or
dialog.show()) adds nothing. A page without any focusable component is not
applicable: no note. Never pass or violation.
checks.manual_reason: Whether focus can leave a component shows only by operating it with the keyboard (Tab, Shift+Tab, Escape); the accessibility tree cannot tell a trap from a well-behaved modal.
